items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: So Lucky took $25, Taft took $25, Deak took $25, and Bill Kinney... I beat Taft, and I beat Deak, no, I beat Taft and I beat Lucky

ctx.x: The three Ink Spots and the bandleader.
The band leader, and the saxophone player named Taft Smith.
